html:
Here is a shot of a galaxy cluster (constellation Virgo) taken on the night of March 12-13, 2008 around 1:30. It is a stack of 30 photos of 60 sec at ISO 800 with 30 darks and 10 flats. Stacking in Nebulosity under Mac OS X.5
Camera: Canon EOS Rebel xti
Lens: Soligor 135mm F2.8 at F4.5
Site: Grand-Mère
Mount: Alt-Az ( rotation is visible at the edge of the photo)

In the coming days, I'll publish enlargements of a few galaxies appearing in this shot.



UPDATE- Here are three enlargements showing a few dozen galaxies.
